future_resource_policy.guard_rule: unknown/stale guard requires owner review; never delete it to proceed
future_resource_policy.disk_rule: check before campaign and each worker; at least 1 GiB plus remaining planned output headroom; increase reservation after small export-size check, never delete historical data
future_resource_policy.budget_semantics: proposed allocation ceilings, not measured runtime guarantees. Do not launch next worker if depleted; preserve current attempt and report resource censoring. No outcome-dependent reduction/replacement. Any expansion requires review.

future_resource_policy.later_lap_or_reliability_campaign: separate authorization/resource estimate; pilot budget cannot establish lap criteria or long-run 0.5% commitment reliability; no full-lap budget implicitly granted
future_resource_policy.evidence_root: future fresh exclusive results/task007f/<approved-study>/<unique-run>; compact docs/task007f/...; never overwrite results/task007d or earlier evidence
